scope: 15 additional held source/owner comparisons; no decision, canonical, manifest or release edit

rows.sourceExample: By Sunday evening, she felt buried under chores.
rows.sourceMeaning: Overwhelmed by household tasks; a physical covering image.
rows.ownerMeaning: Having so much schoolwork that it feels difficult to cope.
rows.recommendation: Household chores and homework both create the same overwhelmed-by-task-load state; review buried under/in + tasks without teaching literal covering.

rows.sourceExample: Delivery is fast, but convenience comes at a price.
rows.sourceMeaning: A benefit has a cost or drawback; a conventional evaluative phrase.
rows.ownerMeaning: Involve a cost or disadvantage, which may be non-financial.
rows.ownerPattern: \bcom(?:e|es|ing) with a price tag\b|\bcame with a price tag\b
rows.recommendation: Both say a convenience has a hidden cost. At a price is an established lexical alternative to with a price tag; owner expansion versus separate form lesson needs editorial choice.

rows.sourceExample: Digital payments are woven into everyday living in the city.
rows.sourceMeaning: Closely integrated into daily routines; a fabric metaphor.
rows.ownerTitle: woven into daily routines / daily life
rows.recommendation: Everyday living and daily life both name ordinary routines; allow woven into everyday living.

rows.sourceExample: The argument began to fall apart under closer inspection.
rows.sourceMeaning: Prove weak when examined carefully; a conventional structural metaphor.
rows.ownerMeaning: Begin to fail or come apart in many connected parts.
rows.classification: likely-distinct source sense; hold for new owner
rows.recommendation: Argument fails when scrutinised, whereas 098 has a multi-part enterprise coming apart at the seams. Do not alias solely on fall apart surface; assess a bounded under-closer-inspection lesson.

rows.sourcePhrase: the bar is definitely being raised
rows.sourceExample: With the new rules, the bar is definitely being raised.
rows.sourceMeaning: Expectations or standards are increasing; a fixed sports metaphor.
rows.ownerMeaning: Set a higher standard for what is expected or required.
rows.recommendation: Passive bar is being raised means the same higher expectation as raise the bar; review passive detector and teaching grammar.

rows.sourceExample: She passes those stories on to her children.
rows.sourceMeaning: Transmits stories to another generation; a natural phrasal verb.
rows.ownerTitle: pass on values / experience and tradition
rows.ownerMeaning: Transmit beliefs about what matters, knowledge gained through experience, or customs, often through teaching, stories or example.
rows.ownerPattern: \bpass(?:es|ed|ing)? on (?:our |their |his |her |the )?(?:values|experience and tradition)\b|\bpass(?:es|ed|ing)? (?:our |their |his |her |the )?(?:values|experience and tradition) on\b
rows.recommendation: Passing stories to children is intergenerational transmission like values/tradition; broaden to stories after checking story examples.

rows.sourceExample: We used the letters to piece it together.
rows.sourceMeaning: Combine fragments into a coherent understanding; a fixed puzzle image.
rows.ownerMeaning: Combine separate pieces of evidence to understand a whole situation.
rows.recommendation: Piece it together from letters means combine fragments into a coherent picture, matching new owner 2411 piece the puzzle together; extend pattern only with clear it antecedent.

rows.sourceExample: Digital payments are deeply woven into everyday life.
rows.sourceMeaning: Closely integrated into daily routines; a fabric metaphor.
rows.ownerTitle: woven into daily routines / daily life
rows.recommendation: Deeply woven into everyday life is ordinary integration, matching 1503 daily-life sense.

rows.sourceExample: One video can lead a child into a rabbit hole.
rows.sourceMeaning: A distracting, absorbing path that takes longer than expected; a fixed literary image.
rows.ownerMeaning: Become drawn into an extended chain of exploration that goes beyond the original purpose.
rows.recommendation: Lead into a rabbit hole and go down a rabbit hole both begin extended absorbing exploration; review into/down entry forms.

rows.sourcePhrase: take a lot of pressure off your shoulders
rows.sourceExample: An emergency fund can take a lot of pressure off your shoulders.
rows.sourceMeaning: Reduce a heavy personal burden; a conventional weight metaphor.
rows.ownerTitle: take the weight off my shoulders
rows.ownerMeaning: Reduce someone’s worry, pressure or responsibility.
rows.recommendation: Take pressure off shoulders describes reduced worry/burden, matching 801 weight-off-shoulders meaning. Review pressure as natural bounded alternative.

rows.sourceExample: A larger budget gives the team room to manoeuvre.
rows.sourceMeaning: Freedom to make choices or adjust plans; a fixed spatial image.
rows.ownerMeaning: The smallest amount of freedom to adapt plans or respond, among the people or options being compared.
rows.recommendation: Room to manoeuvre is freedom to adapt; owner 1875 currently teaches the least such room. Need rewrite comparative-specific brief if one owner absorbs general form.

rows.sourceExample: A small allowance is a training ground for adult life.
rows.sourceMeaning: A safe place to practise future responsibilities; a conventional training image.
rows.ownerMeaning: A setting that gives people practice in abilities useful in later everyday life.
rows.recommendation: Allowance as safe practice for adult responsibilities matches 1120 training ground for life; allow adult life while keeping real practice.

rows.sourceExample: The festival has deep roots here.
rows.sourceMeaning: A long-established cultural connection; a plant metaphor.
rows.ownerMeaning: A long-established and strong place within families’ customs or shared experience.
rows.recommendation: Festival has deep roots here is long-established local tradition; 1471 family-life roots teaches same continuity image but narrower domain.

rows.sourceExample: Few new songs leave the same deep footprint for me.
rows.sourceMeaning: Have an equally lasting emotional impact; a footprint metaphor.
rows.ownerMeaning: Make a stronger lasting impression or influence, using a deeper-mark image.
rows.recommendation: Same deep footprint and deeper footprint both concern lasting influence; 2664 source compares songs and its same deep wording needs naturalness review.

rows.sourcePhrase: take the wind out of the industry's sails
rows.sourceExample: Falling sales could take the wind out of the industry's sails.
rows.sourceMeaning: Weaken an industry's energy or progress; a fixed sailing metaphor.
rows.ownerMeaning: In the supplied film context, reduce a work’s energy, suspense or appeal, as if removing the force that drives it.
rows.recommendation: Falling sales taking wind out of industry sails means weakening drive/progress, same sailing metaphor as 422 film-energy use; owner brief must broaden domain before alias.
